actions.script: contactList = [] const asked = Array.from(addressList || []).map(String) const kept = ec.cache.getCache('moqui.test.people.asked') kept.put(String(userId), (kept.get(String(userId)) || '') + ',' + asked.join(',')) const contacts = [ {contactRef: 'SPEC_JANE', name: 'Jane Contact', url: '/qapps/spec/Contact?partyId=SPEC_JANE', addressList: ['tel:+15553334001', 'email:jane.contact@people-spec.example', 'tel:+15553334009']}, {contactRef: 'SPEC_PAT', name: 'Pat Employee', url: '/qapps/spec/Contact?partyId=SPEC_PAT', addressList: ['tel:+15553334002', 'user:CHAT_PEOPLE_SPEC_B', 'tel:+15553334008', 'email:pat.private@people-spec.example']}, {contactRef: 'SPEC_GONE', name: 'Gone User', url: null, addressList: ['tel:+15553334005', 'user:CHAT_PEOPLE_SPEC_GONE', 'email:gone.extra@people-spec.example']}, {contactRef: 'SPEC_BLOCKER', name: 'Blocker Contact', url: null, addressList: ['tel:+15553334006', 'user:CHAT_PEOPLE_SPEC_R', 'email:blocker.extra@people-spec.example', 'tel:+15553334016']}, ] for (const contact of contacts) if (contact.addressList.some((key) => asked.includes(key))) contactList.push(contact)
